lines: Before breakfast, the brass Star Door woke with a clunk.
A note! It says: Find nothing. Five clues will show the way.
Find nothing? Easy. I am brilliant at finding things that are not there!
Let us stay together and look carefully. We will follow every clue.
Look at the five hollow stars at the top. Each clue we find will light one. The first arrow points to the parcel!
Mira, Sol and Tavi followed the first arrow across the observatory. They looked for nothing inside the parcel.
My toy! I knew I packed you.
Now the box has nothing in it.
Let us check. Move the toy outside, then look inside the box.
The toy is outside. The empty box is still here. Empty means the toy is not inside. We found a box, not nothing.
They found an empty box, but they did not find nothing. So they followed the next glowing arrow into the bell room to try there.
Hello! I am Nori. I listen for tiny sounds. May I join your search?
Yes, please, Nori. We are looking for nothing. Let us listen together.
Listen closely. The wind has stopped.
The brass bell hung still. Nori leaned close to listen.
I heard no ring. But I heard my breath, and the bell stayed right there. We found a bell, not nothing.
They heard no ring, but the bell was still there. So the four friends went through the blue door to look for nothing in the paper room.
Here is a card with no mark on it. Shall we test it?
Use your finger. Make a mark, or choose to leave the card blank.
A mark is something we can see. A blank card is still a card. We found a card, not nothing.
They found a card whether it was marked or blank. Then seven wall tiles began to glow, so they tried the word next.
The tiles want us to spell the mystery word. Step with me!
Nothing is a word we can see, say and read. The word stayed here when we named it, so it is not nothing.
The word stayed visible, so it was not nothing. The next golden arrow led the four friends to a red curtain to try again.
My toy rolled behind the curtain. I cannot see it now!
Let us slide the curtain slowly and watch what appears.
There it is! Hidden is not gone. The curtain changed what we could see. We found the toy, not nothing.
They had tried five places and found something each time. Their five bright stars opened the great Star Door.
Two little doors waited. Door A offered a card. Door B offered no object.
The note said, find nothing. Which door showed us nothing? Let us inspect both.
Neither door showed nothing. A showed a card. B showed no object, so we do not invent one.
The friends solved the door puzzle. Before going home, they carried the bright map into the library to remember where their search began.
Before we file the map, what did Sol call empty in the first room?
The box was empty, but it was still here. The toy was outside. We searched every room and found no nothing.
